Hi!
I work at a POKéMON MART.\pIt's part of a convenient chain
selling all sorts of items.\pPlease, visit us in VIRIDIAN CITY.\pI know, I'll give you a sample.
Here you go!
Please come see us if you need\nPOKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.
{PLAYER} put the POTION away in\nthe BAG's ITEMS POCKET.
See those ledges along the road?\pIt's a bit scary, but you can jump\nfrom them.\pYou can get back to PALLET TOWN\nquicker that way.
